name: Banu Mărăcine

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Seasons this warm ripen Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc, Sémillon, Cabernet Franc and Tempranillo fully without cooking off their freshness.

soil.rock: Gravel drains fast and is poor, so roots go deep for water and food. It holds little water. Sand is warm and airy. It drains fast but holds little water, and phylloxera does not thrive in it. Clay holds water well but drains poorly. It stays cool, which slows ripening and keeps acidity up.
soil.top: The topsoil stores water through dry spells, but stays wet and cold after rain, which slows ripening and can swell the grapes. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
